It should support payment and balance settlement for approved mileage, meal, and supply reimbursements while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Volunteer Dispatch Expense Settlement Board, preserve the nonprofit operating context. UI shape: decision tree plus handoff queue.
